content: Book editorial review includes 5 new criteria: (7) Consistent character names/personas across every chapter and across series books. (8) Series flow — transition between books, proper recaps, tone continuity, ending hooks. (9) Engagement/bestseller readability — page-turner quality, pacing analysis, emotional resonance required. (10) Plot coherence — every setup has payoff, cause-and-effect visible, no deus ex machina. (11) Genre-appropriate formatting — consistent chapter headers, uniform scene breaks, proper paragraph/dialogue format. All 11 checks are in the book-editorial-review skill.
